name: Block public SSH ingress
description: Deny AWS security groups that allow SSH from 0.0.0.0/0

name: Block public RDP ingress
description: Deny AWS security groups that allow RDP from 0.0.0.0/0

name: Block public S3 ACL
description: Deny public S3 bucket ACLs where detectable in Terraform plan JSON

name: Prevent S3 encryption removal
description: Deny Terraform plans that delete S3 server-side encryption configuration

name: Require Environment tag
description: Deny managed resources that do not include an Environment tag

name: Require Owner tag
description: Deny managed resources that do not include an Owner tag

name: Block IAM wildcard administrator policy
description: Deny IAM policies that allow Action * on Resource *
